# Household

> Household runs terminal agents (Claude Code, Codex) as personal assistants you talk to in Telegram. Each agent
> ("pet") lives in its own microVM; a daemon on the user's Mac or Linux machine proxies all its traffic through an
> allowlist and puts API keys into requests on the way out, so agents only ever see placeholders.

Setting it up is done when the user writes to their Telegram bot and a pet answers. Work through the
[setup checklist](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/install.md).
Household installs with `curl -fsSL https://agents-household.dev/install.sh | sh` (no Bun, Docker or sudo);
`house onboard` then walks the user through the rest in their terminal (key, house, bot, pet), and `house update`
moves to a newer release.

Install the `household` agent skill too, for running Household afterwards:

- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add underwear/household && claude plugin install household@household`
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add underwear/household && codex plugin add household@household`

## Docs

- [Setup](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/install.md): the checklist from a bare machine to a pet answering in Telegram
- [Operating](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/operate.md): what Household can do (pets, network, secrets, scouts), updates, backups
- [Debugging](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/debug.md): where to look when a pet, scout or channel does not work
- [Skill overview](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/SKILL.md): concepts

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/underwear/household): TypeScript on Bun; `house --help` lists every command
